parameters.name: hcn_nmr.inp
parameters.content:
! PBE0 def2-TZVP RKS NMR NoAutoStart
%maxcore 192
%scf MaxIter 256 AutoTRAH false end
%eprnmr Ori = GIAO end
* xyzfile 0 1 hcn.xyz

entries.purpose: Initial fixed HCN geometry for GIAO shielding

goal_giao_nuclear_shielding.gap: Awaiting inspection of the completed ORCA shielding output before the analysis producer can be planned

goal_shielding_tensor_and_isotropic.gap: Awaiting inspection of the completed ORCA shielding output before the tensor parser can be planned

goal_isotropic_trace_consistency.gap: Awaiting tensor values before the trace-consistency check can be planned

goal_deliver_artifacts.gap: Initial actual input will be produced now; final table/script/report producers depend on the completed ORCA output

goal_random_seed_record.gap: Will be recorded from the actual structure preparation and any stochastic steps after execution

goal_shielding_constants_not_chemical_sh.gap: Will be enforced in the report/table producer after inspecting the shielding output

proposal.reason: Plan first resolves/prepares the initial HCN identity and geometry, writes the actual PBE0/def2-TZVP RKS GIAO NMR input, and runs one managed ORCA calculation. The science analysis and delivery producers are intentionally deferred until the real ORCA output files can be inspected, avoiding a parser written against an assumed output format.
